title: Inside The Building, Not Outside It
label: ch:la-pared-y-el-techo
canDo: I can say la pared, el techo, el piso, el rincon and el fondo, and place a thing inside a room instead of inside a town.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C355-fondo: name the wall, the ceiling and the floor of a room, and put a thing in its corner or at its back.
